projects.name: AI Collections Cloud
projects.description: An AI-native recovery platform for lenders — collector copilot, recovery prediction, and next-best-action over a clean domain, data, and event architecture.

projects.name: Enterprise Lending Cloud
projects.description: A unified LOS + LMS + collections + analytics engine — workflow state machines, EMI math, and deterministic demo data, all client-side.

projects.name: Dashboard Studio
projects.description: A drag-and-drop dashboard builder — KPI cards, charts, data profiling, theming, and export, with data that never leaves the browser.

projects.name: Synthesis — Strategic Framework Engine
projects.description: An offline strategic-framework builder: import data, configure the analysis, and export to PDF, Markdown, CSV, or JSON — entirely in-browser.

projects.name: Excel Transformer
projects.description: A client-side spreadsheet tool to drop, rename, filter, and re-export Excel/CSV files — no data leaves the page.

projects.name: Excel Merger
projects.description: An in-browser tool to merge multiple Excel/CSV files — column strategies, header normalization, and gap-fill — fully offline.

projects.name: NeuralPath — AI Concepts Game
projects.description: A gamified AI-learning app — concepts, quizzes, XP, streaks, and orchestration flows that teach AI one level at a time.
